description: Put an uploaded file (an image) in a particular place of the site — replaces src in the tag found. A safe operation: checksum, lock, an Undo-compatible checkpoint. Use it instead of update_portal_page when only one image must be replaced.

css_selector.description: CSS selector to find the img element (an alternative to current_src)

current_src.description: The current src of the image to replace (URL or relative path)

media_id.description: File ID from MyFile (from diamant_upload or the media library)

page_checksum.description: SHA256 of the page's current HTML — taken from the checksum field of get_portal_page's answer. Required, to guard against parallel changes.

name: place_media_on_site
